sentences.text: For loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on business-purpose loans to Micro and Small Enterprises. (E3, E6)
The cited UCB rule therefore points to non-compliance with a 2% pre-payment charge on an MSE loan if the sanction letter falls within that rule’s effective period. (E3, E6)
The evidence does not give the sanction date, so the rule’s applicability to this specific sanction letter cannot be confirmed from the record provided. (E6, E13)

The bank’s policy says 2% foreclosure charges plus GST are levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, but the UCB directions also say undisclosed pre-payment charges shall not be charged. (E2, E15)

missing.searched: Needed to confirm whether the sanction letter is covered by the UCB pre-payment-charge rule applicable to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026.
